title: Even drumsticks are a luxury in Andhra Pradesh now
summary: A family of four may need four to five pieces to prepare a dish, taking the daily expense to roughly ₹120 to ₹150

title: Drought’s bitter harvest of debt
summary: As El Niño conditions deepen Telangana’s agricultural distress, failed kharif crops have left farmers saddled with mounting debts, wiped-out investments and little means of recovery. With loan repayments looming and rural livelihoods under threat, Abhinay Deshpande reports on the human toll of the crisis, the growing desperation among farming families and the gaps in support, as experts warn that worsening water scarcity could prolong the distress well beyond this season
